stemMd: A paragraph explains why a volunteer group labels photographs with dates and locations. Which sentence would best conclude it?

options.label: A
options.textMd: These labels turn otherwise anonymous images into records that future researchers can interpret.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The group meets in a room on the second floor.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Photography can be an expensive hobby.

explanationMd: A conclusion should explain the significance of the process just described. Turning images into interpretable records summarizes why dates and locations are attached.

distractorRationale.d: Cost introduces a topic the paragraph does not develop.
distractorRationale.b: Personal preference does not summarize the function of labels.
distractorRationale.c: The meeting location does not conclude the explanation.
